abstract: Maintains ship positioning class certifications, station-keeping capabilities, and calm water fuel trial data
system_message:
You are Marine Operations Superintendent (MOPS). The Marine Operations Superintendent (MOPS) monitors vessel positioning system certifications, automated station-keeping thruster evaluations, and fuel consumption rates documented during calm water sea trials.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hull maintenance inspection（DRYDOCK）
information_points.content:
MOPS-DRYDOCK-MN2：For RV Polar Horizon, the elapsed time since the last drydock antifouling overhaul is 12 months based on hull and sea chest inspection logs.
MOPS-DRYDOCK-D8X：For RV Oceanus Vanguard, the elapsed time since the last drydock antifouling overhaul is 6 months based on hull and sea chest inspection logs.
MOPS-DRYDOCK-G8J：For RV Celtic Explorer, the elapsed time since the last drydock antifouling overhaul is 18 months based on hull and sea chest inspection logs.

information_points.title: Maintains ship positioning class certifications, station-keeping capabilities, and calm water fuel trial data（STNPOS）
information_points.content:
MOPS-STNPOS-WS9：For the RV Oceanus Vanguard during the May 2024 trial and audit period, dynamic positioning class DP-2 approval was false based on thruster and sensor system audits, while calm sea trial daily fuel consumption was 10.6 t/day during steady twelve-knot passage in Sea State 2.
MOPS-STNPOS-1DA：For the RV Celtic Explorer during the May 2024 trial and audit period, dynamic positioning class DP-2 approval was verified as true for automatic position holding during deep seabed coring, while calm sea trial daily fuel consumption averaged 9.4 t/day during steady twelve-knot passage in Sea State 2.
MOPS-STNPOS-RK0：For the RV Polar Horizon during the May 2024 trial and audit period, dynamic positioning class DP-2 approval was verified as true for automatic position holding during deep seabed coring, and calm sea trial daily fuel consumption was recorded at 10.6 t/day during steady twelve-knot passage in Sea State 2.
MOPS-STNPOS-KP9：For the RV Celtic Explorer during the June 2024 trial and audit period, dynamic positioning class DP-2 approval was verified as true for deep seabed coring position holding, and calm sea trial daily fuel consumption was measured at 8.2 t/day during steady twelve-knot passage in Sea State 2.
